name: HEDONITES OF SLAANESH: ACCURSED REFLECTION
description:
The Accursed Reflection is the fourth creation of the unfortunate sorcerer Vannatan, rumoured to have been glimpsed on battlefields all across the Mortal Realms. Its presence is never requested, yet arrive it does, preying upon magic and unleashing a parade of manic manifestations of its own.

Spew Forth Sin

This multipart plastic kit builds The Accursed Reflection – a Regiment of Renown for your Blades of Khorne, Disciples of Tzeentch, Helsmiths of Hashut, Maggotkin of Nurgle, Skaven, and Slaves to Darkness armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. The individual units can also be used in your Hedonites of Slaanesh army, and you'll save money compared to buying them individually. This Regiment of Renown is built around a Contorted Epitome, a daemonic spellcaster that spews forth Wheels of Excruciation, Mesmerising Mirror, and Dreadful Visage Manifestations during your battles.

This boxed set builds 4 multipart plastic Hedonites of Slaanesh miniatures:
– 1 Contorted Epitome
– 1 Wheels of Excruciation
– 1 Mesmerising Mirror
– 1 Dreadful Visage

Contents:
– 43 plastic components, including 1 integrated base
– 1 Citadel 75mm by 42mm Oval Base
– 2 Citadel 90mm by 52mm Oval Bases
– 1 construction guide

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints

This boxed set is only available while stocks last.
